title: Autoxide agent eval result
description: Result of one run of the sample-task eval for real AI agents (roadmap 71-G4, consumed by scripts/release-metrics.py via --agent-eval; the release workflow reads docs/quality/agent-eval.json when it exists at the release commit). One file = one run: a fresh agent with only the public docs and the API/MCP endpoint is given each sample task and a task counts as done only when a machine check of the resulting server state passes. Threshold for 1.0: passed / tasks above 0.90.

model.description: Model identifier of the agent that did the tasks.

version.description: Autoxide version the server under test was built from.

passed.description: Number of tasks whose machine check passed.

cost_usd.description: Total cost of the run in US dollars, when known.

failed.description: The tasks that failed; its length is tasks - passed.

task.description: Stable ID of the sample task.

reason.description: Why it failed (for example the API error code the agent could not get past, or the check that did not hold).
